scripts.build: npm run check && vite build --mode firefox && vite build --mode chrome
scripts.build:firefox: npm run check && vite build --mode firefox
scripts.build:chrome: npm run check && vite build --mode chrome
scripts.package: python3 scripts/clean.py && npm run build && python3 scripts/package.py && npm run package:source
scripts.package:firefox: python3 scripts/clean.py firefox && python3 scripts/clean.py source && npm run build:firefox && python3 scripts/package.py firefox && npm run package:source
scripts.package:chrome: python3 scripts/clean.py chrome && npm run build:chrome && python3 scripts/package.py chrome
